body.name: Completed-label connectivity state
body.construction: At node \(t\), a state is \(q=(\lambda,\pi,c)\), where \(\lambda:B_t\to\{1,\ldots,K\}\), \(\pi\) is a partition of \(B_t\) refining the fibers of \(\lambda\), and \(c\in\{0,1\}^K\). Each block of \(\pi\) is one connected component of the processed \(G\)-edges meeting \(B_t\). The invariant is that every processed component of an unfinished label meets \(B_t\); \(c_k=1\) exactly when the unique connected component of label \(k\) has been closed and label \(k\) is absent from \(B_t\).
